summary: 1U 25.6 Tbps fixed switch with 32 QSFP-DD ports for 100/200/400 GbE leaf and spine roles.

management.note: Management-port details were not extracted from the QuickSpecs.

value.ports: 32 QSFP-DD supporting 100, 200, or 400 GbE, plus 2x 10G SFP+
value.breakout: 128 x 100 GbE or 64 x 200 GbE using breakouts. 25 or 50 GbE split-out was described as a future software release.
value.role: 100 GbE leaf or 100/400 GbE spine. QuickSpecs cite EVPN-VXLAN leaf and spine and storage QoS with AOS-CX.
value.scaleExamples: Up to 6000 x 25 GbE servers or 2000 x 100 GbE servers per the overview, described as 8x the CX 8325-32C 25 GbE scale.

value.planningBasis: Higher published 100% traffic rate at 230 VAC. R9A30A is 688 W at 100% traffic and 221 W idle. R9A29A is 675 W at 100% traffic and 210 W idle.
value.psu: 2 redundant hot-swappable power supplies. QuickSpecs also list 1500 W and 1600 W PSU SKUs; those ratings are not the system draw.

value.storage: 128 GB m.2 SSD, 4 GB mSATA, 16 MB SPI flash

firmwareBaseline.reason: The QuickSpecs refers to the most recent AOS-CX release without naming a version in the extract.

referenceConfigurations.title: 32-port 100/200/400 GbE spine or leaf
referenceConfigurations.note: Published hardware population. Not a cabling design.
